answer: Collateral is slashed jointly when correlated behavioural faults fire inside the same window. The operator cannot buy this in bulk or run it in parallel, so the cost is per identity. The inlet is the collateral at risk, the delta the behavioural signature that groups identities, and the canyon the joint forfeiture that punishes the group: splitting into many delta groups avoids the joint loss but scatters the inlet into smaller, individually useless stakes.
